basic_details.job_title: MSEDCL Chief Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Four posts of Chief Engineer (Dist.) are open at Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Ltd. (MSEDCL) under Advertisement No. 03/2026 dated 18 November 2026. Applications in the prescribed format, with a demand draft and attested copies of certificates, must reach the Asst. General Manager (HR-RC), Recruitment Cell, MSEDCL, Bandra (East), Mumbai - 400051 on or before 04 December 2026. The application may be sent by Speed / Registered Post, by courier or by hand.

For reservation, candidates should be domicile of Maharashtra State and of a category notified by Maharashtra. Women have 30% horizontal reservation; for women under Open and SC/ST categories, the Non-Creamy Layer certificate is not required, provided the other conditions of the GR are met. The Caste/Tribe mentioned in the application cannot be changed later.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application goes by post or by hand to this address, exactly as printed: Asst. General Manager (HR-RC) RECRUITMENT CELL, MSEDCL, 4th Floor, Prakashgad, Bandra (East), Mumbai - 400051. The Company is not responsible for postal delay, and applications received after the due date will not be entertained. If a candidate applies more than once, the last/latest application will be considered. No correction is allowed after the final submission, and no call letters will be dispatched by post or courier.

Experience counts only after obtaining the essential qualification. Qualification and experience are considered as on 18/11/2026. content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Demand Draft for the application fee (where applicable). Copies of testimonials in support of age, caste, caste validity certificate, qualifications and experience, attested. Current Non-Creamy Layer Certificate (for backward class categories under the creamy-layer rule). MSEDCL candidates: the copy of the letter received from the CR cell with the Annual Confidential Ratings (ACR) for the last five consecutive years, obtained from the Office of the Confidential cell, MSEDCL, Ground Floor Prakashgad, Mumbai. Outsider candidates: Annual Performance Appraisal Ratings (APARs) / complete and up-to-date confidential reports for the last 5 consecutive years, in original or a photocopy attested by the candidate (mandatory). Outsider candidates working in Govt. / Semi Govt. Undertakings: No Objection Certificate. Persons with disability: copy of the Medical Certificate from the appropriate Medical Board, and the disability certificate with UDID No. as asked in the form.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted for the selection process/Assessment Center Process on the basis of qualification, experience, job responsibility, APR etc. In case of a higher response, the management reserves the right to conduct a screening exercise. MSEDCL candidates must meet the ACR benchmark for promotion, and the ACR/APR of outside candidates will be matched with MSEDCL's qualifying criteria before they can take part in the Assessment Center process. The Assessment Centre Process may involve In-Basket Writing and In-Basket Interaction Exercise, Presentation Writing and Presentation Making Exercise, Group Discussion Exercise and Case Discussion Exercise. The total marks in the in-basket exercise (excluding interview) will be converted into 100% marks. Open category candidates (or those applying against Open) scoring less than 40%, and OBC candidates scoring less than 30%, will not be considered for the Personal Interview. Group Discussion and in-basket exercise are held at Mumbai, at the candidate's own cost. Candidates will be shortlisted for Personal Interview in the ratio of 1:3 of the advertised posts, based on performance in group discussion, presentation and in-basket exercises etc. The Company may decide which methodology of shortlisting or selection to adopt, at its absolute discretion. The recruitment process is entrusted to Indian Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS), and the list of shortlisted applicants will be made available on www.mahadiscom.in .

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MSEDCL Chief Engineer (Dist.) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 posts of Chief Engineer (Dist.): 1 for OBC and 3 for Open category, which the notice calls provisional.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the MSEDCL Chief Engineer (Dist.) post?
faq.answer: The application must reach the MSEDCL Recruitment Cell in Mumbai on or before 04 December 2026; late applications will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for MSEDCL Chief Engineer (Dist.)?
faq.answer: A Bachelors Degree in Electrical Engineering/ Technology is required, with 15 years' Power Sector experience (including the prescribed Power Distribution and Superintending Engineer service) or 3 years as Superintending Engineer.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for MSEDCL Chief Engineer (Dist.)?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 50 Years as on 18/11/2026, relaxable by 5 years for backward class candidates applying against reserved posts; for MSEDCL employees it is 57 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of MSEDCL Chief Engineer (Dist.)?
faq.answer: The scale of pay is Rs. 140655-5980-272215, with DA, HRA, Medical Benefit, Leave Encashment, CPF and Gratuity etc. as per Company rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for MSEDCL Chief Engineer (Dist.)?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.708/- for Open category and Rs. 354/- for reserved category (both including CGST & SGST), paid by demand draft; PwD candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for MSEDCL Chief Engineer (Dist.) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the prescribed application form with the demand draft and documents to Asst. General Manager (HR-RC) Recruitment Cell, MSEDCL, 4th Floor, Prakashgad, Bandra (East), Mumbai - 400051 by Speed / Registered Post, courier or by hand.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for MSEDCL Chief Engineer (Dist.)?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates go through an Assessment Centre Process with in-basket, presentation, group discussion and case discussion exercises, followed by a Personal Interview in the ratio 1:3.

faq.question: Q9. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: Write "MSEDCL ADVT. NO. 03/2026: APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF CHIEF ENGINEER (DIST.), MSEDCL" on top of the envelope.

faq.question: Q10. Is there a service bond for the MSEDCL Chief Engineer (Dist.) post?
faq.answer: Yes, selected candidates other than departmental employees must execute a Surety Bond of Rs.1 lakh on Non-Judicial Stamp Paper to serve MSEDCL for 3 years.
